c277fd563613cda6767258838574386d16e830eb.summary: Analysis by the Swiss government CERT (GovCERT) of Fobber, an eBanking trojan first described by Malwarebytes as a spinoff of Tinba. Its code stays encrypted until each function is called, then is re-encrypted. It is self-contained and resolves imports by hashing function names. The samples share one encryption key and seem to come from one campaign. As of publication, no Swiss financial institutions were known to be targeted. The report was published September 11, 2015 and updated November 26, 2015.
